modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: Discontinued or closed to new customers, confirmed on the live site 2026-09-29. Homepage https://www.shuttle.dev/ still renders the old 'Build Backends. Fast.' marketing page with no shutdown banner, which is why the earlier pass saw it as live; the shutdown notice is only in the docs (docs.shuttle.dev/docs/shuttle-shutdown). DISCONTINUED: Shuttle announced it is ceasing operations; Community tier data deleted from beginning of 2026, Pro projects stopped Jan 16 2026, Growth customers migrated individually. Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

snapshot_auto.quote: You app can use the file system like normal, but files in the deployment container are deleted after the deployment stops.
snapshot_auto.note: Ephemeral AWS ECS Fargate containers; nothing is saved on stop. Service discontinued anyway.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: files in the deployment container are deleted after the deployment stops.
snapshot_on_demand.note: Rust PaaS; state lives in provisioned resources (shared Postgres, RDS, OpenDAL), no machine snapshot feature in docs.

harness_api.quote: Your assistant can help you deploy services, **fetch logs**, and interact with the Shuttle console - all through natural conversation.
harness_api.note: The Shuttle MCP server lets a local coding assistant drive Shuttle; it does not run or drive an agent inside the platform.

ingress_rules.quote: HTTPS traffic is proxied to your app on the project's default subdomain and any [custom domains](/docs/domain-names) that have been added.
ingress_rules.note: Single public HTTPS endpoint per project; no IP allowlists, private mode or auth controls documented.

guest_firewall.note: App runs as a container on AWS ECS Fargate ('Deployments run in AWS ECS with Fargate VMs'); Fargate does not grant CAP_NET_ADMIN and Shuttle exposes no capability settings.

secret_proxy.quote: `SecretStore::get` can now be called to retrieve your API keys and other secrets at runtime.
secret_proxy.note: Secrets from Secrets.toml are delivered into the app process; no injecting proxy.

volume_attach.quote: files in the deployment container are deleted after the deployment stops.
volume_attach.note: No persistent volumes; persistence only via managed databases / object storage (OpenDAL) resources.

volume_shared.quote: files in the deployment container are deleted after the deployment stops.

usage_api.quote: pub struct ProjectUsageResponse { pub build_minutes: ProjectUsageBuild, pub vcpu: ProjectUsageVCPU, pub daily: Vec<ProjectUsageDaily> }. Response for the /user/me/usage backend endpoint returning HashMap<String, ProjectUsageResponse> keyed by project_id. Includes billable_vcpu_hours and reserved_hou
usage_api.note: granularity: per-project; cost: no; Shuttle (archived Jan 2026) provided /user/me/usage endpoint returning billable usage per project as quantities (build minutes, VCPU hours). Service discontinued; API no longer operational but code evidence shows it tracked per-project billable metrics.
